name: Return to Verner
summary: You carry fifty freshly forged horseshoes from Goldshire back to Lakeshire. Smith Argus has finished the order, and Verner Osgood is waiting across the border in Redridge.

sections.title: A Courier Across the Border
sections.body: Smith Argus has forged fifty horseshoes for Lakeshire, and you carry them east from Goldshire. Redridge faces supply shortages and gnoll attacks. The iron shoes help keep horses and draft animals working on its rugged mountain roads.

sections.title: The Note on the Crate
sections.body: Verner Osgood is relieved when the horseshoes arrive, but Smith Argus has attached a bill to the crate. Verner is annoyed that the Goldshire smith expects payment. Redridge faces pressing dangers, leaving little time to argue over the charge.

faq.q: Where do I take the Crate of Horseshoes?
faq.answer: Take the crate to Verner Osgood in Lakeshire, in the Redridge Mountains just east of the bridge and lakeside docks.

faq.q: Who sent this delivery back to Redridge?
faq.answer: Smith Argus, the blacksmith outside the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, sends the crate after finishing the horseshoes.

faq.q: Why is Verner upset when he receives the crate?
faq.answer: Smith Argus attached a bill demanding payment for all fifty horseshoes, and Verner is irritated. He had apparently hoped for a free favor or easier terms.

faq.q: What quests open up after completing this delivery?
faq.answer: After this delivery, Verner offers work against local threats: hunt the Redridge gnolls in 'A Baying of Gnolls' and fetch 'Underbelly Scales'.

faq.q: Why does Lakeshire need supplies imported from Goldshire?
faq.answer: Gnolls and Blackrock orcs besiege Lakeshire, stretching local craftsmen thin. The town often needs everyday goods like bulk iron horseshoes from quieter places such as Goldshire.

faq.q: Does Smith Argus accompany you back to Redridge?
faq.answer: No. Smith Argus stays at his forge in Goldshire while you carry the crate to Redridge.

angles.text: As a blacksmith, you know frontier mounts need steady supplies of horseshoes when local forges are overwhelmed by war.
As an Alliance member, you help keep outlying settlements like Lakeshire connected to the kingdom's heart through supply lines between Elwynn Forest and Redridge.
